const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboLab limited-mode controller for red_dishes_in_bin.
+
+This file records the live control session. It connects once, exposes a
+single-waypoint helper for safe visual servoing, and saves every response.
+"""
+import os
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+obs = r.get_obs(video="none")
+os.makedirs("/app/output/episode", exist_ok=True)
+_action_no = 0
+_ori = np.array(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][11:15], dtype=np.float32)
+
+def pose(x, y, z, grip=0, quat=None, note=""):
+    """Drive one Cartesian waypoint, retain the response, and print status."""
+    global obs, _action_no
+    _action_no += 1
+    q = _ori if quat is None else np.asarray(quat, dtype=np.float32)
+    a = np.array([[x, y, z, *q, grip]], dtype=np.float32)
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", a, video="mp4", note=note)
+    res.save(f"/app/output/episode/{_action_no:02d}")
+    obs = res
+    print(_action_no, note, "done=", res.meta.get("done"),
+          "reason=", res.meta.get("reason"), "plan=", res.meta.get("plan"),
+          "time_left=", res.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
+    return res
+
+def look(seconds=0.0):
+    """Fetch fresh views (optionally watch while holding the last command)."""
+    global obs
+    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video="mp4")
+    print("observe", seconds, "done=", obs.meta.get("done"),
+          "time_left=", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
+    return obs
+
+print("Connected; initial EE:", obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][8:15],
+      "time_left:", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
